items.headline: Albemarle Names BHP Executive Ragnar Udd as Next CEO
items.snippet: Albemarle named BHP executive Ragnar Udd as its next CEO. Albemarle idled its Kemerton lithium hydroxide plant in Australia earlier this year citing prolonged price volatility. Market conditions have since shown improvement with recovering lithium pricing.

items.headline: Why Is Albemarle (ALB) Up 5.4% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.snippet: Albemarle posted second-quarter 2026 adjusted earnings of $3.75 per share, up from 11 cents a year ago, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $3.35 by 11.9%, supported by stronger lithium pricing, Specialties growth and productivity gains.

items.headline: Albemarle to Benefit From Low-cost Assets, Brownfield Opportunity, RBC Says
items.snippet: RBC Capital Markets said Albemarle will likely benefit from low-cost assets, brownfield opportunity, and continued focus on earnings improvement in Specialties. RBC has an outperform rating on Albemarle and decreased the company's price target to $157 from $166.
